summary_1line: Markandeya describes cosmic cycles, Kali Yuga’s moral decline, the fiery-pralayic destruction of the universe, and his vision of the divine child containing the cosmos within.
themes: vision of Vishnu as cosmic child

image_candidates.scene_text: Seven blazing suns rise in the sky and dry up the oceans while the world burns beneath them.
Markandeya floats alone on a boundless flood and sees a radiant child resting on a banyan branch above the cosmic waters.
Inside the divine child's body, Markandeya beholds the entire universe—mountains, rivers, gods, and cities—spread across an inner world.
